57498520.description: 2CT2-2-EtO, also known as 2-ethoxy-4-ethylthio-5-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to 2C-T-2.

71554840.name: TRPV3-74a

71599640.name: Empesertib
71599640.description: Empesertib is an experimental drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme monopolar spindle 1 kinase . It is in clinical trials for the treatment of breast cancer.

72695064.name: TRV734

78357784.name: AP20187

86345880.name: Eltanexor

91820312.name: Pretenellin A

101085592.name: Palladium tetrafluoride

121513880.name: RN-9893

124173720.name: Inavolisib

129866008.name: 4',7-Dihydroxy-6-methoxyflavone

139143320.name: Decacarbonyldihydridotriosmium

172866200.name: Technetium (99mTc) mebrofenin
172866200.description: Technetium mebrofenin is a diagnostic radiopharmaceutical used for imaging of the liver and the gallbladder.

900000024.name: 2-FXPr
900000024.description: 2-FXPr is a designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, which is believed to have dissociative effects.

900000408.name: Cantuzumab mertansine
900000408.description: Cantuzumab mertansine is an antibody-drug conjugate investigated to treat colorectal cancer and other types of cancer.

900000920.description: HM15275 is an experimental drug that works as a GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptor agonist. It is developed by Hanmi Pharmaceutical.

900001048.name: Isolichenan
900001048.description: Isolichenan, also known as isolichenin, is a cold-water-soluble α-glucan occurring in certain species of lichens.

900001304.name: NB-5-MeO-DALT
900001304.description: NB-5-MeO-DALT, also known as 5-MeO-DALT BOC or as N1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-5-methoxy-N,N-diallyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families related to 5-MeO-DALT.

900001432.name: Opicinumab
900001432.description: Opicinumab is a fully human monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of multiple sclerosis, acute optic neuritis , and other associated demyelinating diseases.

900001560.name: Plasminogen (medication)
900001560.description: Plasminogen, sold under the brand name Ryplazim, is a biologic medication for the treatment of hypoplasminogenemia .

900001944.name: Syrup of ipecac

900002200.name: Zalutumumab
